narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Small Silk Pack, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ha ha! Thanks, pal. I owe you. <Kzixx reaches into a Small Silk Pack already in his possession, filled to the brim with coin, and pulls out a fist full. He counts out a tiny fraction of his total wealth, and hands it to you.> This should cover it. No take-backs!
narrative.requestItemsText: Yo! Is that pack for me?

giverName: an item: Craftsman's Writ: Small Silk Pack
